video_title: Yaxel Lendeborg Admitted This in Our Interview

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on building connections with Draymond Green and Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: I've spoken a lot more towards Dray and Steph, not just questions but just normal conversation wise.
quotes.quote: I've spoken a lot more towards Dray and Steph, not just questions but just normal conversation wise. It is great for me to get out of the star-struck space. It helps me a lot. The other guys like B-Well, Mel, those guys that I haven't really got to speak to as much, I'm getting to talk to them a lot more, just make better connections and bonds with them too.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on feeling star-struck at Warriors training camp
quotes.excerpt: I'm still kind of star-struck now. I just get to talk to them whenever I want.
quotes.quote: I'm still kind of star-struck now. I just get to talk to them whenever I want. It's really crazy having that experience. It's definitely going to take a little getting used to. I'm recording to Steph, Dray, both of them, Al Horford as well, and then Jimmy.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on calling Draymond Green 'Grandpa Al'
quotes.excerpt: I called Draymond my grandpa sometimes because he doesn't want to dunk.
quotes.quote: I said it like two times. He hasn't said nothing yet, so I'm going to continue to say it. If he doesn't like it, I got to wait to hear because I don't know yet. I call Draymond my grandpa sometimes because he doesn't want to dunk, so he's definitely grandpa to me too.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on the high attention to detail in Warriors practice
quotes.excerpt: The attention to detail was at all-time high. We can't go through one drill without making it perfect.
quotes.quote: The attention to detail was at all-time high. We can't go through one drill without making it perfect. That's something I really appreciate because I know I'm a guy that has a lot of questions about everything. Being that they answer the question before I even get to ask is making it way easier on me.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on earning the respect of veterans through defensive play
quotes.excerpt: Earning would be like defensively, showing that I want to win and not try to get spotlight.
quotes.quote: Earning would be like defensively, showing that I want to win and not try to get spotlight and be that one guy trying to overcome Steph and stuff. Just making the right play at the right times. Me just making that extra one more two-step is something that's going to be vital for us. If I pass one of them, and Steph has a good look, give that to Steph.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on learning from Draymond Green's defensive wisdom
quotes.excerpt: Being able to get the wisdom from him is definitely going to help me out.
quotes.quote: Being able to get the wisdom from him is definitely going to help me out in the long run and short run. Yesterday, the conversation was going towards me and my aggressiveness on offense. Defensively, a lot of that has just been me asking him questions on where I need to be on the floor, if I should be here early or late. It's all going to be trial and error for me.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on the viral 'NBA Twitter' comment
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't say heckle, but I was kind of jokingly heckle for saying that comment.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say heckle, but I was kind of jokingly heckle for saying that comment, saying that I was going to get benched and cut already for saying stuff like that. It was kind of funny then to experience that. I'm always on Twitter, always reading stuff on Twitter, so hearing those things and seeing those things is very, very funny. Kyrie was my guy, I said it, you know.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on the lack of pressure as a rookie
quotes.excerpt: I'm coming in to just fill a role, you know. Steph and Draymond have been the guys.
quotes.quote: I'm coming in to just fill a role, you know. Steph and Draymond have been the guys that have been running the team here. They've won four championships, they've pretty much done everything. So me, my job here is just to fill in, fall in line, do what's needed. I don't think there's any extended pressure for me. I have some time to learn, some time to grow.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on his personal expectations for efficiency
quotes.excerpt: I just want to be able to play efficiently, you know. Not have games where I'm shooting.
quotes.quote: I just want to be able to play efficiently, you know. Not have games where I'm shooting one for 30 and have five turnovers a game. My expectation is a little different, and everybody's expectations and thoughts are going to be a lot different than me no matter what. I could have a game where I shoot 10 for 10 and have two turnovers, they say it's a bad game because of the turnover.
